in_sanskrit.name: विदुर्मुख
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One with a face that reveals knowledge and wisdom.

in_marathi.name: Vidurmukh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Disciple of Dharma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Vidurmukh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Vidurmukh refers to the disciple of Dharma, who was known for his wisdom and unbiased judgement.

in_bengali.name: Vidurmukh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Disciple of Dharma
in_bengali.long_meaning: Vidurmukh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Vidurmukh refers to the disciple of Dharma, who was known for his wisdom and unbiased judgement.
